name: com.offlineprotocol/hosted
title: Offline Protocol (hosted)
description: Offline Protocol package, workflow and integration guidance over HTTPS. Needs an app API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Offline Protocol application API key as a bearer token. Organization keys are not accepted.

api_key.description: Application API key from the Offline Protocol developer portal

headers.name: x-app-id
headers.description: Application id that owns the API key. It must match the key's application.
